{{Quote|One that turned out to be run by a Zeltron who was as pretty as a Tellanadan moonflower and as mean as a Hismauli hawk-snake.|Lando Calrissian, on a brewery's operator|<ref name="Warfare" />}}
The '''Tellanadan moonflower''' was a pretty [[Plant/Legends|plant]]<ref name="Warfare" /> from the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim's]]<ref name="EAOC" /> [[Tellanada system/Legends|Tellanada system]],<ref name="EAOC" /><ref name="Planetnamia" /> in existence by the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]].<ref name="The New Essential Guide to Characters">''[[The New Essential Guide to Characters]]'' dates the [[Battle of Taanab/Legends|Battle of Taanab]], which occurred before [[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]] came into ownership of the [[Unidentified brewery|brewery]], to [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]].</ref> [[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]], a professional [[Gambling/Legends|gambler]], once compared a [[Unidentified Zeltron (Clendor)|Zeltron]] who ran a [[Unidentified brewery|brewery]] owned by him on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Clendor]] to the [[Flower/Legends|flower]] because of the prettiness shared by both of them.<ref name="Warfare" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Tellanadan moon flower was first mentioned in [[2012]]'s ''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]'', written by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Paul R. Urquhart]] as a guide dedicated to the conflicts in the ''[[Star Wars]]'' [[The galaxy/Legends|galaxy]].
